title: Running time of the pair-code validity tester
statement: For every finite Boolean word $x$, there exists a natural number $s$ such that the pair-code validity tester, started on $x$, is halted after exactly $|x|+1$ steps, has output the one-bit word whose bit is true precisely when the aligned pair parser successfully decodes $x$, and uses exactly $s$ work-tape cells.
